text: UIQ-08 is now separately admitted for solid, opaque inspection-toolbar integration after the candidate-only Slice 758 closeout. Slice 759 is In Progress under uiq_inspection_toolbar; the accepted candidate source stays immutable, glass is rejected, and all control behavior plus exact OFF fallback remain protected. The embedded flag cannot be remotely switched; rollback requires code-default change and redeployment.
